baseline_models.focus_anchor: 31:33 words 3 and 6-18: the protective imperative, severe day, and mirrored parent-child negation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The self is placed behind protection before a crisis in which the strongest expected human proxy is denied in both directions. The repeated recompense construction makes responsibility non-transferable rather than merely lonely.

activation_trace.role: Putting the self within protection supplies the reflexive defensive posture.
Standing in for another supplies the substitution explicitly denied twice.
Parenthood supplies the strongest expected transfer bond, tested in both directions.
A severe event supplies the arriving crisis against which protection matters.

changed_reading.before: Taqwa is a general command to be pious before judgment.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa is self-placement behind protection for a crisis in which even parent and child cannot stand in for one another.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 31:33 words 5-6 and 20-22: fearing a day because the divine promise is true.
baseline_models.mechanism: The knowledge-like edge of fear joins a time-bounded promise to reality that is fixed rather than merely asserted. The command asks for present epistemic alignment with a future event.

activation_trace.role: Fear used with a knowledge-like force lets apprehension function as recognition.
A promise bounded by an appointment supplies a future that has structure rather than vagueness.
Stable correspondence with reality makes the future claim cognitively binding now.

changed_reading.before: Fear is chiefly an emotion prompted by a future warning.
changed_reading.after: Fear becomes informed recognition: a promised severe event is treated as fixed reality before it arrives.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 31:33 words 24-30: the near life and a deceiver are separately barred from deceiving about God.
baseline_models.mechanism: Proximity and present usefulness make life look self-validating, while deception converts surface brightness into confidence about an unknown outcome. The two prohibitions preserve two channels: misreading life itself and accepting misleading speech about God.

activation_trace.role: The nearer or first world supplies the temporal proximity that distorts valuation.
Life as benefit and good explains why the lure can be genuinely useful rather than simply evil.
A shining but unstable lure supplies the deceptive surface shared by both prohibitions.
Uncertainty about outcome turns present confidence into a hazardous wager.

changed_reading.before: Worldly life tempts through attractive pleasures.
changed_reading.after: The near, useful life misprices its own horizon: what shines now obscures outcome, while the repeated deception targets both life-perception and speech about God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 31:33 words 4 and 9-17: the Lord relation stands beside four kinship forms.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two branch families of Lordship supply formation, completion, feeding, and growth; the mirrored genealogy then denies that biological nurture can become substitution. Vertical sustaining relation and horizontal descent are not interchangeable kinds of care.

activation_trace.role: Repair, upbringing, and completion make Lordship an ongoing formative relation.
The split target's feeding and growth image adds bodily development to formative care.
Human parenthood supplies the parallel nurturing bond whose proxy power is limited.
Substitution is the precise function denied to genealogy, not the reality of kinship.

changed_reading.before: Your Lord is an authority beside the human parent-child relation.
changed_reading.after: The Lord is the relation that forms and completes the person; biological nurture remains real but cannot become a proxy at accounting.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: 31:33 words 2 and 9-17: all people are addressed before the nearest family bond is made non-substituting.
baseline_models.mechanism: The mapped human branch presents people as beings who seek familiarity and relief from estrangement. The ayah addresses that social self, then exposes the limit of belonging without denying companionship itself.

activation_trace.role: Companionship that removes estrangement supplies the social expectation carried by the universal audience.
Descent supplies the intimate belonging on which rescue might be presumed.
The denied standing-in function marks the boundary of social belonging.

changed_reading.before: The universal address simply broadens the warning to everyone.
changed_reading.after: It addresses humans precisely as companionship-seeking beings, then exposes belonging's limit: social intimacy does not transfer accountability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Purchased, continually renewed discourse displaces attention; refusal then hardens from hearing without understanding into an ear imagined as bearing weight. The focus deception can therefore operate as an attentional pipeline before it becomes a false belief.

activation_trace.role: The unstable lure supplies the focus mechanism whose entry point is being specified.
Occupation by one thing away from another supplies deliberate attentional displacement.
Speech renewed as news supplies an always-fresh carrier for diversion.
Hearing as understanding and compliance marks the uptake that is being refused.
Weight in the ear materializes the blockage between sound and understanding.

structural_cues: 31:6 places purchased diversion before misguidance; 31:7 repeats a comparison to stage self-sealed hearing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies displacement, renewed speech, failed uptake, and ear-weight; I infer the arrow attention capture to susceptibility to deception. A live alternative is that the sequence diagnoses obstinate refusal without describing deception's mechanics.

changed_reading.before: Deception is mainly accepting a false proposition about life or God.
changed_reading.after: Deception begins by controlling what remains hearable: novelty displaces attention until misleading surfaces no longer face effective comparison.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier promise-and-truth collocation is attached to enduring reward. Its recurrence in the focus warning makes the promise two-sided: the severe accounting is credible within the same durable future that carries hope.

activation_trace.role: A spoken promise that opens hope prevents the focus noun from collapsing into threat alone.
Reality-stability certifies the focus promise.
Persistence resistant to passing away supplies the positive promise's durable horizon.
The same hope-opening promise branch links reward to the focus formula.
The repeated reality branch makes the contextual echo resolvable rather than thematic.

structural_cues: 31:9 places the repeated promise-and-truth pairing immediately after enduring gardens, whereas 31:33 places it between failed kin substitution and two deception warnings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact root-pair recurrence and permanence; I infer that the later formula recalls both assurance and warning. A live alternative is that each formula independently certifies its local proposition without deliberate cross-reference.

changed_reading.before: The true promise in 31:33 primarily certifies the threatened day.
changed_reading.after: The true promise spans durable reward and unavoidable accounting, so fear is framed by a trustworthy two-sided future rather than threat alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pregnancy, repeated weakness, and continuing companionship establish a costly filial bond; refusal of obedience in one domain limits that bond without canceling it. The focus denial of substitution is another boundary internal to kinship, not a declaration that kinship is worthless.

activation_trace.role: The focus parent relation supplies the bond whose judgment-day function is being delimited.
The repeated parent relation supplies an explicit duty-bearing context for the same bond.
Internal bearing and fruit supply the embodied cost behind filial obligation.
Repeated loss of strength intensifies the cost without granting proxy power.
Obedient submission supplies the specific filial function that can be refused.
Continued companionship supplies the care that survives refusal of obedience.

structural_cues: 31:14 repeats weakness and joins gratitude to parents; 31:15 coordinates refusal of obedience with continued decent companionship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies costly generation, bounded obedience, and retained companionship; I infer that non-substitution is a further functional boundary rather than relational severance. A live alternative is that 31:33 concerns only final accounting and does not revise the earlier family ethic.

changed_reading.before: The day renders the parent-child bond simply useless.
changed_reading.after: Kinship keeps gratitude, care, and companionship, but it cannot command false allegiance or transfer one person's account to another.

context_deltas.mechanism: A weighed seed hidden at any spatial extreme is still retrievable because minuteness and inward concealment remain known. This activates the focus's indefinite thing as a denial of both relational substitution and a de minimis escape.

activation_trace.role: A knowable, reportable thing gives the indefinite object maximal accountable scope.
Denied substitution supplies the legal-social side of the no-escape mechanism.
A precise weight supplies accountable measure at minute scale.
The mustard seed supplies the material minimum used to test scope.
Smallness, fineness, and hiddenness connect minute scale to concealed location.
Knowledge of an affair's interior closes concealment as an escape route.

structural_cues: 31:16 nests the tiny weighted object inside rock, heavens, or earth and then reverses concealment with divine retrieval.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies minute weight, concealment, and inward knowledge; I infer that these scope the focus's indefinite object to no de minimis exception. A live alternative is that 31:16 demonstrates power and knowledge without specifying final accounting.

changed_reading.before: No family member can pay anything for another.
changed_reading.after: No relational proxy works, and no hidden or minuscule thing falls beneath the resolution of the account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context explicitly pairs exposed and inward blessing, then describes disputation without illumination. The near life's deception becomes a surface-selection error: the visible is real but is mistaken for the whole.

activation_trace.role: The nearer world supplies the perceptually available layer favored by the error.
A gleaming unstable lure converts availability into misplaced confidence.
Exposure and visibility supply the outward evidence that dominates attention.
The hidden interior supplies the real but underweighted counterpart.
Illumination supplies the missing means for seeing beyond the exposed layer.

structural_cues: 31:20 sets outward and inward in an explicit pair, then closes with a threefold lack of knowledge, guidance, and illuminating record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an outside-inside contrast and absent illumination; I infer that proximity deceives through surface selection. A live alternative is that the closing critique targets unsupported argument specifically, not perception in general.

changed_reading.before: The near life deceives because its visible goods are false.
changed_reading.after: Its visible goods can be real yet partial; deception occurs when the exposed layer is treated as exhaustive and the inward horizon is left unlit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Self-protection gains an embodied positive action: orient the person toward God, grip, rely on what is firm, and let the end disclose the grip's adequacy. Protection is attachment to reliable support, not mere retreat from danger.

activation_trace.role: Putting oneself in protection supplies the focus posture being revised.
Holding and retaining supply the active bodily form of protection.
Firm construction supplies the reliability of what is held.
The final outcome supplies the temporal test of attachment.

structural_cues: 31:22 word 10 is the uncited object of gripping because its root has no branch inventory; face-to-God precedes the grip and the end of matters follows it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gripping, firmness, and final outcome; I infer that these give the protective imperative a positive attachment mechanism. A live alternative is that the grip remains only a general faith metaphor with no intended relation to the focus imperative.

changed_reading.before: Protection means avoiding what will harm the self.
changed_reading.after: Protection is enacted by sustained attachment to what remains firm through the final outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pleasurable benefit is granted real extension but explicitly small duration; a forced transition then exposes a harsher sequel. The near life's deception is temporal discounting rather than the simple falsity of enjoyment.

activation_trace.role: Nearness supplies the short horizon that dominates present valuation.
Uncertainty of outcome supplies the risk hidden by that horizon.
Enjoyable benefit concedes that the present good is experientially real.
Smallness limits duration and prevents present benefit from defining the whole sequence.
Necessity and compulsion supply the irreversible turn after enjoyment.
Harsh treatment supplies the qualitative contrast concealed by short-term valuation.

structural_cues: 31:24 uses a sequencing particle to flip brief enjoyment into compelled arrival at severe consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies benefit, small duration, compulsion, and harshness; I infer that deception works by discounting the sequel. A live alternative is that the verse contrasts delay and punishment without modeling the hearer's cognition.

changed_reading.before: Worldly enjoyment deceives because it is unreal or intrinsically corrupt.
changed_reading.after: Its benefit may be real but brief; deception is allowing a short interval to erase the compelled sequel from valuation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night and day enter one another while celestial bodies run toward a set limit. The promised day is not a detached date outside present life; it is the boundary already carried within ongoing temporal motion.

activation_trace.role: A duration rather than a mere daylight unit lets the focus day receive processual depth.
An appointed promise supplies the terminal toward which motion is read.
Mutual entry supplies time as interpenetrating transition rather than static blocks.
Continuous running supplies directed temporal motion.
A fixed endpoint supplies the limit internal to that motion.

structural_cues: 31:29 mirrors night entering day and day entering night, then assigns each celestial body motion toward a named limit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal transition, running, and a fixed endpoint; I infer that the focus day is a terminal already approached by present motion. A live alternative is that the sequence demonstrates cosmic governance without commenting on felt temporal distance.

changed_reading.before: The feared day is a remote static appointment after worldly life.
changed_reading.after: Present life is already running through reversible cycles toward an irreversible limit; deception freezes as permanent what is actively moving.

context_deltas.mechanism: Enveloping instability strips away rival confidences and produces sincerity; separation from danger is followed by betrayal and concealment of benefit. The focus double deception can name a rescue-amnesia cycle in which safety restores the surface confidence that crisis had punctured.

activation_trace.role: The shining unstable lure supplies the confidence that returns after danger recedes.
A covering that encompasses supplies total crisis exposure.
Interlocking turbulence supplies the unstable environment that defeats ordinary control.
Escape by separation supplies the state change from engulfment to safety.
Betrayal and failure to keep faith supply post-rescue reversal.
Covering a benefit supplies the memory failure that makes renewed deception possible.

structural_cues: 31:32 moves through an engulfing when-clause, sincere invocation, a rescue transition, and then divided human responses on land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies engulfment, sincerity, rescue, betrayal, and covered benefit; I infer a crisis-to-safety memory arrow. A live alternative is that the verse classifies responses after rescue without asserting a psychological cycle in each person.

changed_reading.before: Worldly deception is strongest while people are immersed in danger or pleasure.
changed_reading.after: Deception can return after rescue: safety covers the remembered source of deliverance and converts relief into renewed confidence in the nearest surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah distributes hidden generation, tomorrow's acquisition, and the place of death around repeated personal non-knowledge. This brings the focus day and parent-child axis into ordinary uncertainty: each self emerges from hidden kinship yet cannot know or transfer its own next boundary.

activation_trace.role: The severe event supplies the ultimate unknown boundary.
Birth and generation anchor the context's hidden beginning back to the focus kinship forms.
The womb supplies hidden personal origin within kinship.
Knowledge explicitly negated twice supplies the human epistemic limit.
The self as the very entity individualizes both unknown future clauses.
Seeking and obtaining benefit supplies the ordinary future people plan as controllable.
The next day supplies the nearest future that already exceeds personal knowledge.
Loss of life and power supplies the personal boundary whose location remains unknown.

structural_cues: 31:34 repeats the no-self-knows construction and places hidden origin, next-day acquisition, and death-place around divine knowledge of the final hour.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden generation and two individualized unknown futures; I infer that these domesticate the focus warning into everyday epistemic dependence. A live alternative is that the closing inventory marks divine knowledge without intentionally extending the non-substitution mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The feared day is an abstract final event at which family help fails.
changed_reading.after: Its logic is already present in each self's unknown origin, tomorrow, and death-place: kinship generates persons but cannot know or carry their temporal boundary for them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it activates the non-dominant ج ز ز target under the focus root ج ز ي. It remains anchored to both recompense occurrences and the severe day, but downstream prose must label cutting and harvest as a material analogy, not a translation or preferred morphology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: 31:33 words 6, 8, and 15: the severe day contains two forms of the split-mapped recompense root.

activation_trace.role: Cutting supplies an exploratory image of severing each account from kin proxy.
Ripeness for cutting supplies a harvest-time model for the arriving day.
The severe event contains the material harvest analogy within the focus ayah.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is a legal exchange that no relative can perform for another.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the day is also a ripeness-and-cutting point at which intertwined family growth is severed into individually gathered accounts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because it activates the non-dominant ع و م target under the focus root و ع د through the sea scene. It remains anchored to the promise word and contextual motion, but downstream prose must mark it as a cross-domain navigational analogy, not etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: 31:33 word 20: the promise carries split targets for swimming motion and the span of a year.

activation_trace.role: Swimming or vessel-like passage supplies motion through an unstable medium.
The yearly span supplies duration across which the promise remains live.
Flowing motion activates the promise's passage image in context.
Vast water supplies the uncertain medium across which directed trust travels.

changed_reading.before: The promise is a proposition about a future event.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the promise is a traversable current spanning years: present motion can carry the hearer toward an unseen shore rather than justify trust in the nearest surface.

strongest_changes: The exact 31:9 echo makes the true promise carry enduring reward as well as unavoidable accounting.
The family sequence revises non-substitution into a boundary within continuing gratitude and companionship, not kinship's erasure.
Minute hidden weight, visible-versus-inward blessing, and short enjoyment turn the warning into a high-resolution critique of scale, surface, and time horizon.
The sea sequence makes deception recur after rescue through covered benefit and failed memory.
summary.what_was_special: Split-root branches produced two contained material readings, while repeated syntax preserved distinct legal, social, epistemic, temporal, and navigational models instead of forcing one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The knowledge-like force of the fear root may be rhetorical reinforcement rather than a full epistemic recoding.
The causal arrows from attention capture and post-rescue safety to deception are abductive; the packet also supports non-causal moral description.
The harvest and cross-year passage outliers depend on non-dominant mapped roots and must remain analogies rather than lexical claims.
